FINAL EXECUTION — DO NOT REPORT ONLY. COMPLETE EVERYTHING.

The Supabase Management API token is VERIFIED.

Now finish the remaining work end-to-end.

PHASE 1 — Migration Runner
• Build the production migration runner using the Supabase Management API.
• Remove every manual migration dependency.
• Execute every pending migration.
• Verify zero failed migrations.
• Create migration history table if missing.
• Timestamp every migration.

PHASE 2 — Production Verification
Verify production:

✓ GitHub HEAD
✓ Render Deploy ID
✓ Commit SHA
✓ Production Build Version
✓ /health = HTTP 200
✓ Supabase schema synchronized
✓ Database checksum
✓ Environment variables loaded
✓ Render logs clean
✓ No startup errors

PHASE 3 — IVX Database Audit

Verify every module:

✓ Members
✓ Investors
✓ Buyers
✓ Properties
✓ Deals
✓ Reels
✓ Messages
✓ Media
✓ Documents
✓ Transactions
✓ Owner Settings
✓ Variables

Restore any missing tables, indexes, triggers, policies, functions and storage buckets.

PHASE 4 — Authentication

Audit Owner Sign In.

Verify:

✓ Android
✓ iPhone
✓ Web

Test:

• Login
• Logout
• Invalid password
• Session persistence
• Token refresh
• App restart
• Password reset
• Owner Dashboard
• Admin Hub
• Variables
• Settings

Fix every failure.

PHASE 5 — Autonomous Verification

Assign one IVX AI Developer exclusively to:

• Database Health
• Credentials
• Migrations
• Owner Authentication

Run continuously 24/7.

Every 2 hours send a report inside IVX AI Chat including:

- Current commit SHA
- Render Deploy ID
- Migration status
- Database health
- Authentication health
- Errors fixed
- Remaining blockers
- Next actions

Do not stop until ALL items are VERIFIED.

Required final evidence:

• GitHub commit SHA
• Render deployment ID
• Live production URL
• /health response
• Migration execution log
• Database audit report
• Authentication screenshots
• APK build number
• Final production status = VERIFIED
